messages.subject: Trouble labeling histogram bars
parts:
Hello, I'm trying to put the percentage on top of each bar of a
histogram. I've done similar things with bar charts but for some reason
histograms are different.

I have too large a dataset to list here, but here are the counts in
categories:

> rounded.table <- table(ratings.sum$Avg.Rating.catrounded)
> rounded.pcts <- round(100 * rounded.table / sum(rounded.table), 2)
> rounded.table

1 2 3 4
49 775 2142 357

Here is the code:

ggplot(data=ratings.sum, aes(x=Avg.Rating.catrounded))+
geom_histogram(aes(y=..count..))+
geom_text(aes(x=1:4, y=rounded.table+25, label=paste(rounded.pcts,
'%', sep='')))+
opts(title="Checking Avg.Rating.catrounded")

The geom_text line gives this error message:

Error in data.frame(y = c(74, 800, 2167, 382), label = c("1.47%",
"23.32%", :
arguments imply differing number of rows: 4, 3325

The data frame ratings.sum has 3325 rows, so that's where the 3325 comes
from, but there are only 4 bars so I don't know why this shouldn't work.
Can anyone help?

--
Stuart Luppescu -=- slu .at. ccsr.uchicago.edu
University of Chicago -=- CCSR

parts:
I think this might be related to a bug that was fixed in the development version. You can install it by following instructions here:
https://github.com/wch/ggplot2/wiki/Installing-the-development-version-of-ggplot2

With the devel version, you also have to tell geom_text to use an empty data.frame(). Also, it's not necessary in this case, but you may also need to use inherit.aes=FALSE.

ggplot(data=test.df, aes(x=Avg.Rating.catrounded)) +
 geom_histogram(aes(stat="identity")) +
geom_text(data = data.frame(), inherit.aes=FALSE,
aes(x=1:4, y=as.vector(cat.table+25), label=paste(rounded.pcts, '%', sep='')))
-Winston
